label: GOD_4 wills GOOD_4 to each distinct intellectual effect, from causal willing
description: Second support option for the restricted premise, without the divine self-case premise DivineOwnGoodWilling. For a GOD_4 g with will and a distinct intellectual x in act as to being whose being g causes, CausalExistenceWilling (a94c5dfc) gives that g wills x its good in esse, and the q.5 a.1 coextension (00e962ae) gives that x is good in esse because it is in act in esse. Conditional consequence; both premises stay open.
